lines.en: label dormwar2:
scene wintersky
I wind up waiting in my office until the[school] day comes to a close.
lines.zh: 我在办公室里一直等到[school]的一天结束。

lines.en: When I was kicked out of the room, I didn’t expect whatever weird shit the girls were planning to last more than like thirty minutes, but it is what it is I suppose.
lines.zh: 我被赶出房间的时候，没想到她们在筹划的那些奇怪玩意儿会持续超过差不多三十分钟，不过事已至此，我也只能认了。

lines.en: At least it was quiet in there and I got to nap for a few hours.
lines.zh: 至少里面很安静，我还得以小睡了几个小时。

lines.en: I’m a bit curious as to exactly what is going on with the apparent dorm war, though.
lines.zh: 不过，我对这场所谓的宿舍大战到底是怎么回事还挺好奇的。

lines.en: Especially since I am now being followed home by two girls with microphones.
lines.zh: 尤其是在我现在被两个拿着麦克风的女生一路跟回家之后。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews1
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你们在干什么？

lines.en: : Molly MacCormack here with Floor 2 News! Sir, what do you have to say in regard to your decision to become the judge of the first annual dorm wars?
lines.zh: : 这里是二楼新闻台的 Molly MacCormack！先生，对于您决定出任首届宿舍大战的评委，有什么想说的吗？

lines.en: : Any expectations? Sleeper picks for contest winners?
lines.zh: : 有什么期待吗？有没有看好的黑马选手？

lines.en: : I don’t even know what any of you are competing in yet. And where did you get the microphones?
lines.zh: : 我都还不知道你们要比什么。还有，你们从哪儿弄来的麦克风？

lines.en: : Ayane Amamiya of Action News Now reporting in!
lines.zh: : 即时新闻台的 Ayane Amamiya 为您报道！

lines.en: : They’re not even plugged into anything.
lines.zh: : 它们根本连电都没插上啊。

lines.en: : Sensei, there have been several accusations that you may be playing favorites in this competition.
lines.zh: : Sensei，有人指责说您在这场比赛中可能会偏袒某些人。

lines.en: : What do you have to say about them and how much do you love me?
lines.zh: : 对此您有什么要说的？还有，您到底有多爱我？

lines.en: : I really hope you two don’t plan on doing this the entire weekend.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你们俩不打算整个周末都这么搞。

lines.en: : We very well may do that, Sir! The war is not expected to end until Sunday night, and it is up to us to interview not only you, but all of the combatants involved!
lines.zh: : 我们完全有可能这么做，先生！这场大战预计要到周日晚上才会结束，而我们要采访的不只是您，还有所有参赛选手！

lines.en: : Cool. Go talk to them, then.
lines.zh: : 挺好的。那就去采访她们吧。

lines.en: : Their segment doesn’t begin until we get to the dorms! Right now, it’s teacher time!
lines.zh: : 她们的环节要等我们回到宿舍才开始！现在可是老师时间！

lines.en: : Ayane, again, please stop calling it teacher time.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我再说一次，别再叫它老师时间了。

lines.en: : So, uhh...this is new.
lines.zh: : 呃……这可真新鲜。

lines.en: : You don’t know the half of it.
lines.zh: : 你还不知道更离谱的呢。

lines.en: : I’m kind of surprised you’re as accepting of it as you are, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我有点意外你居然这么能接受，Maya。

lines.en: : I kind of thought you’d be all like, “Blahhh. My name is Maya and I don’t want to have {i}fun!{/i}” or something.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会是那种“呜哇哇。我叫 Maya，我不想玩得{i}开心{/i}！”的样子呢。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I’m plenty of fun.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我可有趣了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you normally become anti-fun whenever Sensei is involved and he’s basically the prize for this competition.
lines.zh: : 是啦，但只要牵扯到 Sensei，你通常就会变成扫兴专家，而他基本上就是这场比赛的奖品。

lines.en: : I honestly don’t care whether we win or lose. I just thought it would be nice to actually do something for once.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我才不在乎输赢。我只是觉得，偶尔真的去做点什么也不错。

lines.en: : So sue me if that’s too out of character, I guess.
lines.zh: : 所以，要是这太不像我的作风，那你就告我好了。

lines.en: : Sir, word on the street is that the dorm war is going to kick off with one of the most heated battles of the entire weekend.
lines.zh: : 先生，有小道消息说，这场宿舍大战将以整个周末最激烈的对决之一拉开帷幕。

lines.en: : That’s right. It looks like Ami and Noriko are going to be competing head to head in a battle for your affection! How do you expect them to react when {i}I{/i} am crowned the winner?
lines.zh: : 没错。看起来 Ami 和 Noriko 将在争夺您的宠爱的比赛中正面对决！当{i}我{/i}被加冕为冠军时，您觉得她们会作何反应？

lines.en: scene dorminterviews2
: Ayane, if you even {i}show up{/i} during my battle with Noriko, our friendship is over.
lines.zh: : Ayane，要是你在我和 Noriko 的比赛里{i}露面{/i}，我们的友情就到此为止。

lines.en: : I don’t even need to show up in order to win. That’s how much Sensei loves me.
lines.zh: : 我根本不需要露面就能赢。Sensei 就是这么爱我。

lines.en: : Let the record show that I am going to be as unbiased in judging these contests as I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 在此声明，我在评判这些比赛时会尽我所能地保持公正。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: Maybe.
lines.zh: 也许吧。

lines.en: We’ll see.
lines.zh: 走着瞧。

lines.en: : Whatever happens, just don’t let that fucking psycho bitch win.
lines.zh: : 不管结果如何，别让那个该死的疯婆子赢。

lines.en: : Ami’s a much better candidate than her in literally every way. She’s sure to win.
lines.zh: : Ami 在方方面面都比她强太多了。她肯定会赢。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews3
: Wow. Are you actually participating in this?
lines.zh: : 哇。你还真参加啊？

lines.en: : Why does everyone seem so shocked by that?
lines.zh: : 为什么每个人都这么震惊？

lines.en: : Aww, Maya...you really think I’m better than Noriko?
lines.zh: : 哇，Maya……你真的觉得我比 Noriko 强？

lines.en: : I think everyone is better than Noriko. But yeah, I’m pretty sure you’re going to win.
lines.zh: : 我觉得谁都比 Noriko 强。不过是啊，我很确定你会赢。

lines.en: : I mean, I know I’m going to win. But I’m happy to hear you’re on my team.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我知道我会赢。不过很高兴听到你站在我这边。

lines.en: : Sensei, I know you agreed to remaining impartial, but you {i}do{/i} realize that the competition is only hours away and three of the four girls with you are from the first floor.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我知道您答应了要保持中立，但您应该也{i}意识到{/i}，比赛只剩几个小时了，而跟您在一起的四个女生里有三个来自一楼。

lines.en: : What would be your response if word of this was to start circulating around the area?
lines.zh: : 如果这件事的传言在这一带传开，您会作何回应？

lines.en: : That you followed me home and started harassing me.
lines.zh: : 那就是你们一路跟到我家，然后开始骚扰我。

lines.en: : Sir! A word on your expectations in the Ami vs Noriko battle? You haven’t given us your pick yet.
lines.zh: : 先生！关于 Ami 对 Noriko 这场，您有什么预期吗？您还没给出您的选择呢。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews4
: I don’t even know what they’re competing in yet. Am I even allowed to?
lines.zh: : 我都还不知道她们要比什么。我到底能不能说啊？

lines.en: : We don’t know! That much wasn’t established in the rules.
lines.zh: : 我们也不知道！规则里没写明这一点。

lines.en: : But it would probably be better off left as a surprise!
lines.zh: : 不过保持神秘感应该更好！

lines.en: : Well then I can’t give you my pick.
lines.zh: : 那我就没法给你我的选择了。

lines.en: : Also, no more questions please. You two are crowding me and making it hard to walk.
lines.zh: : 还有，别再问了。你们俩挤得我都没法走路了。

lines.en: scene black
Of course, neither one of them agrees and I am questioned the entire way back to the dorm.
lines.zh: 当然，她们俩谁都不同意，回宿舍的一路上我都在被盘问。

lines.en: And, even more annoyingly, I don’t even get to go inside.
lines.zh: 而且更烦人的是，我连里面都进不去。

lines.en: Instead, all of the girls band together and inform me that in order for me to steer clear of any potential strategies, I have to head home right away.
lines.zh: 女孩们反倒联合起来通知我，为了让我避开一切可能的战术，我必须马上回家。

lines.en: I still don’t know what exactly the first contest is, but I know it begins in the morning.
lines.zh: 我到现在也不知道第一个比赛项目到底是什么，但我知道它早上开始。

lines.en: So I guess I’ll just...head back and go to sleep early or something.
lines.zh: 所以我想我就……回去早点睡之类的吧。

lines.en: I wouldn’t say I’m excited for whatever is going to happen tomorrow, but I’m not {i}unexcited{/i}.
lines.zh: 我不敢说明天要发生的事让我很兴奋，但我也不是{i}不期待{/i}。

lines.en: In fact, I think there’s a pretty high likelihood that some of these battles could get a little heated.
lines.zh: 事实上，我觉得其中某些对决很有可能会变得相当火爆。

lines.en: I just hope that anyone who I wind up voting {i}against{/i} doesn’t wind up harboring any sort of ill will toward me.
lines.zh: 我只希望那些最后被我投了{i}反对{/i}票的人，不会因此对我怀恨在心。

lines.en: That is the last thing I need right now.
lines.zh: 那是我现在最不需要的东西。

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile, on the second floor...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时，在二楼……{/i}

lines.en: scene dorminterviews5
: Molly MacCormack, back again and joined by two of the biggest underdogs on the second floor.
lines.zh: : Molly MacCormack 又回来了，这次和我一起的是二楼最不被看好的两位选手。

lines.en: : Noriko, or should I call you the Paralytic Pink Psion of the Old Realm-
lines.zh: : Noriko，或者我该称呼你为“旧域的瘫痪粉红念力使”——

lines.en: : Just Noriko is fine.
lines.zh: : 叫我 Noriko 就行。

lines.en: : Then, Noriko, your matchup with Ami Arakawa has been voted almost entirely out of favor for you given her closeness to Sensei and his potential favoritism.
lines.zh: : 那么，Noriko，考虑到 Ami Arakawa 与 Sensei 关系亲密、而 Sensei 又可能会偏袒她，你和她的对决几乎被所有人认为毫无胜算。

lines.en: : How do you expect to tear through the barrier and stake your claim on his heart as the ultimate imouto?
lines.zh: : 你打算如何冲破这道屏障，以终极妹妹的身份在他的心上插上自己的旗帜？

lines.en: : Easy.
lines.zh: : 简单。

lines.en: : I am going to kill Ami.
lines.zh: : 我要杀了 Ami。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews6
: You probably shouldn’t say that stuff when everyone already thinks you’re crazy.
lines.zh: : 大家都觉得你疯了的时候，你最好别再说这种话。

lines.en: : It’s a joke. Ami is going to be tough competition.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。Ami 会是个难缠的对手。

lines.en: : But I think the fact that she’s been a {i}[niece]{/i} forever gives me a leg up.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，她一直是{i}[niece]{/i}这一点反而让我占了上风。

lines.en: : I always looked at Sensei as kind of a big brother. Just a big brother I also wanted to kiss and sexually explore myself with.
lines.zh: : 我一直把 Sensei 当成哥哥看待。只不过是个我还想亲吻、还想和他一起探索身体的哥哥。

lines.en: : So, with that in mind, I think I’ve got a pretty good chance to-
lines.zh: : 所以，考虑到这一点，我觉得我机会还挺大的——

lines.en: scene dorminterviews7
: A-And you, Kirin?! How do you expect to take down Miku, another girl almost guaranteed to win?
lines.zh: : 那、那你呢，Kirin？！你打算怎么击败 Miku？她也几乎是公认必胜的选手了。

lines.en: : Hey! I wasn’t finished talking!
lines.zh: : 喂！我还没说完呢！

lines.en: : Mmm...to be honest, I’m kind of expecting to lose.
lines.zh: : 嗯……说实话，我其实有点觉得自己会输。

lines.en: : I just threw out the athletics test thing because it was the only thing that could come to mind. And I just wanted to go up against Miku.
lines.zh: : 我提出那个运动测试，只是因为我当时只想得到这个。而且我就是想和 Miku 交手。

lines.en: : But, as long as the test doesn’t really involve speed and is more of a strength thing, I think there’s a chance I could surprise everyone.
lines.zh: : 不过，只要测试不怎么考验速度、更偏重力量的话，我觉得我还是有机会让所有人刮目相看的。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews8
: I think so as well! Never give up! And if the need arises, I’ll save my action to help you on your turn!
lines.zh: : 我也这么认为！永远不要放弃！而且如果有需要，我会留着我的行动点在你的回合帮你！

lines.en: : Cool! Whatever that means!
lines.zh: : 好耶！虽然听不懂那是什么意思！

lines.en: : Oh, look! Here comes yet another combatant!
lines.zh: : 哦，快看！又来了一位选手！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews9
: Tsuneyo Tojo, your battle against Maya is seen as one of the biggest toss ups in the entire dorm war. How do you expect to take her down?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo Tojo，你和 Maya 的对决被视为整场宿舍大战中最难预测的一场。你打算怎么击败她？

lines.en: : With brute force and underhanded tactics.
lines.zh: : 用蛮力和卑鄙的手段。

lines.en: : I will crush her the way my father used to crush the necks of chickens in our backyard.
lines.zh: : 我会像我父亲当年在我们家后院拧断鸡脖子那样碾碎她。

lines.en: : Great! Thank you for your time.
lines.zh: : 很好！感谢你接受采访。

lines.en: : Avast ye, scallywag. Open the register and nobody gets hurt.
lines.zh: : 站住，你这狗东西。把钱柜打开，就没人会受伤。

lines.en: : Oh, look! Another two combatants!
lines.zh: : 哦，快看！又来了两位选手！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews10
: Joining me now are what we call the wild cards!
lines.zh: : 现在加入我的是我们口中的“变数”！

lines.en: : Touka and Yasu, no one really knows what to expect of your battles. Do either of you have anything to say about them?
lines.zh: : Touka 和 Yasu，没人真正知道你们的比赛会是什么样。你们两位有什么想说的吗？

lines.en: : What is this? Some kind of interview?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？某种采访吗？

lines.en: : If I have to sign a release form of some sort, I should probably be contacting my attorney first. I don’t know if this is good for my family’s image.
lines.zh: : 如果我要签什么授权书的话，我大概得先联系我的律师。我不知道这对我们家族的形象是否有利。

lines.en: : I don’t fully understand what I’m supposed to do, so I’m hoping someone will be able to help me.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白自己该做什么，所以希望能有人帮帮我。

lines.en: : And, in turn, I will help them any way I can so that when they pass on, they’ll be escorted into the second plane of existence, retaining their memories while leaving their physical form behind.
lines.zh: : 而作为回报，我也会尽我所能地帮助他们，好让他们离世时能被引导进入第二层存在，保留记忆，抛下肉身。

lines.en: : You’ll have to tell me more about that spell some time in the future!
lines.zh: : 那个咒术你以后一定要跟我细说！

lines.en: : But Touka, one more question. A lot of people are wondering how you even wound up in a contest like this in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不过 Touka，还有一个问题。很多人都在纳闷，你到底是怎么会参加这种比赛的。

lines.en: : You’re one of the newest students we have, but...could it be you’re already falling in love with our teacher as well?! Are you another addition to the harem?!
lines.zh: : 你是我们这里最新的学生之一，但……难道说你已经也爱上我们的老师了？！你是后宫的又一个新成员吗？！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews11
: Love?! That man?! Absolutely not! My parents would never allow it!
lines.zh: : 恋爱？！跟那个男人？！绝对不可能！我父母绝不会允许的！

lines.en: : I don’t know how I wound up in this competition either. I just...
lines.zh: : 我也不知道自己怎么就参加了这个比赛。我只是……

lines.en: : Chika seemed so excited, so...
lines.zh: : Chika 看起来那么兴奋，所以……

lines.en: : Either way, I’m wishing the two of you luck! And Yasu, Priestess of the Night and devout worshipper of the Great Old One-
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我祝你们两位好运！还有 Yasu，黑夜的祭司、远古之神的虔诚信徒——

lines.en: : He who sees with no eyes at all, yet all of the eyes in the universe.
lines.zh: : 他不以任何眼睛视物，却拥有宇宙中所有的眼睛。

lines.en: : Precisely!
lines.zh: : 正是如此！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews12
: I just wanted to let you know I’ll be helping you with your dress. So don’t worry about doing too much on your own.
lines.zh: : 我只是想告诉你，我会帮你做裙子的。所以别担心要自己扛太多。

lines.en: : I look forward to your assistance. Please be gentle with your measurements so I do not become too stimulated.
lines.zh: : 我期待你的协助。量尺寸的时候请温柔些，免得我太过兴奋。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews13
: Ah! Perfect timing!
lines.zh: : 啊！来得正好！

lines.en: : Nodoka and Otoha, you two are perhaps the fiercest competitors we have on the second floor.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 和 Otoha，你们俩大概是二楼最强劲的选手了。

lines.en: : Well, apart from myself that is.
lines.zh: : 当然，除了我自己之外。

lines.en: : Are the predictions right? Will you utterly demolish your first floor rivals? Or is there chance at all for an upset?
lines.zh: : 那些预测说得对吗？你们会彻底击溃一楼的对手吗？还是说，有没有可能爆冷？

lines.en: : ...Why are you touching me, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : ……你为什么在摸我，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Hello, Molly. I’d prefer not to speak too much about my role in all of this, but I can assure you that there is no one more experienced with friend zoning people than my roommate here.
lines.zh: : 你好，Molly。我不太想多谈自己在这里面的角色，但我可以向你保证，在把人打进朋友区这件事上，没人比我这位室友更有经验。

lines.en: : Really, please let go.
lines.zh: : 真的，请放开我。

lines.en: : For years and years, Otoha Okakura has done nothing but reject any and all romantic advances. It’s actually quite astonishing.
lines.zh: : 这么多年下来，Otoha Okakura 除了拒绝一切示好之外什么都没做过。说实话相当惊人。

lines.en: : Some people may believe that she is simply waiting for the right person to swoop in and steal her heart, but I am 80%% positive that person is assuredly not Sensei.
lines.zh: : 也许有人以为她只是在等那个对的人从天而降偷走她的心，但我有 80%% 的把握肯定，那个人绝对不是 Sensei。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews14
: Wait, only 80%%? Why would you give Sensei a 20%% chance of being the one to finally make me feel like...that.
lines.zh: : 等等，才 80%%？你为什么要给 Sensei 留 20%% 的机会，觉得他可能就是那个终于让我产生那种……感觉的人。

lines.en: : Just a hunch. Though I may be bumping up the percentage a bit based on what I’d like to see.
lines.zh: : 只是直觉。不过我可能根据自己想看到的场面，把百分比稍微调高了一点。

lines.en: : If anyone can crumble that cool exterior of yours, it could very well be the man you least expect to-
lines.zh: : 如果真有人能击碎你那副冷淡的外壳，那个人很可能恰恰是你最意想不到的男人——

lines.en: scene dorminterviews15
: Oooooookay, I’m going into the room.
lines.zh: : 好——好吧，我回房间去了。

lines.en: : And I’m going to win tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 而且明天我会赢。

lines.en: : Tell Rin in advance that I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 提前替我跟 Rin 说声抱歉。

lines.en: : Oh...um. Yeah. Okay.
lines.zh: : 哦……呃。好的。行吧。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews16
: Oh! And here is the floor captain herself!
lines.zh: : 哦！这位就是楼层长本尊！

lines.en: : Uta Ushibori, Violet Maid of the Ancient West, there are a lot of expectations riding on you as the captain of the second floor.
lines.zh: : Uta Ushibori，远古西方的紫罗兰女仆，作为二楼的楼层长，大家对你寄予厚望。

lines.en: : There sure are! But I don’t want anybody to worry about me, I’ve got this in the bag.
lines.zh: : 那还用说！不过我可不想让谁替我担心，这场我已经十拿九稳了。

lines.en: : Oh? And you’re positive that you’ll be the one taking home the chalice?
lines.zh: : 哦？你确定会是你把奖杯抱回家？

lines.en: : I don’t know anything about a chalice, but I do know that Ayane fell right into my trap and challenged me to the one thing no one has ever emerged from with their life.
lines.zh: : 我不知道什么奖杯，我只知道 Ayane 正中我的下怀，向我挑战了那件从来没人能活着走出来的事。

lines.en: : So you have a history in rap battles?
lines.zh: : 这么说你有说唱对决的经验？

lines.en: : Nope! But I’m still gonna win.
lines.zh: : 没有！但我还是会赢。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews17
: Also, have you seen Io anywhere? Because she was supposed to walk home with me but she kinda just ghosted and now I’m starting to worry.
lines.zh: : 还有，你有在哪儿看到 Io 吗？她本来应该跟我一起走回家的，结果她就这么人间蒸发了，我现在开始有点担心。

lines.en: : I haven’t...
lines.zh: : 我没看到……

lines.en: : You don’t think that maybe she’s avoiding the competition altogether, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会觉得，她是在故意躲开整场比赛吧？

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll come around. If there’s anybody who can get her to cooperate, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 我相信她会想通的。如果说有谁能让她配合，那一定是我。

lines.en: : Just kinda hard to do when she’s AWOL and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是她现在擅自离队什么的，有点难办。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews16
: But that’s a worry for another time! I’ve gotta go psych up the rest of the floor and prepare ‘em for the big day tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 不过那是以后的事了！我得去给楼里其他人打气，让她们为明天的大日子做好准备！

lines.en: : Thanks for doin’ all this interview stuff, Molly! I can’t even imagine what those first floor girls are up to right now!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你做这些采访，Molly！我都不敢想象一楼那帮女生现在在干什么！

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile, on the first floor...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时，在一楼……{/i}

lines.en: scene dorminterviews18
: Ayane Amamiya here with the legendary Action News Now! And joining me today is captain of the first floor, Makoto Miyamura and her trusty sidekick, Miku Maruyama!
lines.zh: : 这里是传说中的即时新闻台，我是 Ayane Amamiya！今天和我一起的是一楼楼层长 Makoto Miyamura，以及她可靠的搭档 Miku Maruyama！

lines.en: : That’s right! Team Makoto for life!
lines.zh: : 没错！永远支持 Makoto 队！

lines.en: : Now, now. There’s no need to call Miku my assistant...even though her contest is basically over already.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。没必要把 Miku 说成我的助手啦……虽然她的比赛基本上已经结束了。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 此话怎讲？

lines.en: : Miku, what do you have to say about this? Are you as confident in yourself as your best friend is in you?
lines.zh: : Miku，对此你有什么要说的？你有像你最好的朋友相信你那样相信自己吗？

lines.en: : Heck yeah! I’m already fired up.
lines.zh: : 那还用说！我已经燃起来了。

lines.en: : I’m just glad that me and Makoto are competin’ in what we’re competin’ in.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴，我和 Makoto 要比的正好是我们要比的项目。

lines.en: : Makoto and I.
lines.zh: : 是 Makoto 和我。

lines.en: : See what I mean? If I had to do any of that smart girl stuff, I’d be as useless as a sprinter in a wheelchair.
lines.zh: : 明白我意思了吧？要是让我去搞那些聪明女生的东西，我就跟坐在轮椅上的短跑选手一样废。

lines.en: : And if Makoto had to do anything even remotely athletic, she’d be even worse off than that!
lines.zh: : 而要是让 Makoto 去做哪怕一丁点跟运动沾边的事，她比那还惨！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews19
: Okay...there’s no need to be rude.
lines.zh: : 好了……没必要这么没礼貌。

lines.en: : What? You know it’s true. Ya can’t even make it around the block without huffin’ and puffin’ and-
lines.zh: : 什么嘛？你也知道这是事实。你连绕街区走一圈都喘得上气不接下气——

lines.en: scene dorminterviews20
: Ignore her. What she means to say is that our floor will be rooming with Sensei at the beach no matter what. You can mark my words.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她想说的是，不管怎样，我们这一层在海边都会和 Sensei 住一起。你记住我这句话。

lines.en: : I would certainly love to. But that doesn’t mean your battle is going to be one of the easy ones.
lines.zh: : 我当然乐意记住。但这并不代表你们的比赛会轻松。

lines.en: : Nodoka Nagasawa is known as a prodigy all throughout Kumon-mi. Do you really think you can take her down in a test of knowledge?
lines.zh: : Nodoka Nagasawa 在整个 Kumon-mi 都被称为天才。你真觉得自己能在知识测验中击败她吗？

lines.en: : There’s only one way to find out, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 只有一种办法能知道答案，不是吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll be a valiant opponent, but I’m going to be a formidable foe.
lines.zh: : 我相信她会是位英勇的对手，但我也会是个棘手的敌人。

lines.en: : And I’ve got the power of determination on my side.
lines.zh: : 而且我这边还有决心的力量。

lines.en: : That’s right! And in manga and stuff, the team that’s more determined always wins! We’ve got this in the bag!
lines.zh: : 没错！而且在漫画什么的里面，更有决心的那一队总会赢！我们稳操胜券！

lines.en: : Well, we’re all certainly looking forward to it!
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们大家都很期待！

lines.en: : Oh! And here comes someone else we’re all looking forward to seeing in action!
lines.zh: : 哦！这位也是我们都期待看到她大显身手的人！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews21
: Sana Sakakibara, how do you feel knowing that you’ll be competing in what many of us here at Kumon-mi are calling the “main event” of the first annual dorm war?
lines.zh: : Sana Sakakibara，得知自己要参加我们 Kumon-mi 许多人称为首届宿舍大战“主赛事”的项目，你有什么感想？

lines.en: : Umm...c...confused?
lines.zh: : 呃……困、困惑？

lines.en: : I still don’t...really know what I’m supposed to do and...a fashion show seems kind of...
lines.zh: : 我还是不太……明白我该做什么，而且……时装秀感觉有点……

lines.en: : Like the opposite of what you want to do?
lines.zh: : 像是你最不想做的事？

lines.en: : Y...Yeah...
: Even though we all love you and cherish you and want to hug you until you pop?
lines.zh: : 尽管我们都很爱很珍惜你，都想抱你抱到你炸开为止？

lines.en: scene dorminterviews22
: But...I don’t want to pop!
lines.zh: : 可是……我不想炸开！

lines.en: : I don’t know the first thing about fashion shows and...even if you all help me...the other girl is so much prettier...
lines.zh: : 我对时装秀一窍不通，而且……就算你们都帮我……另一个女生也漂亮太多了……

lines.en: : Nonsense. She’s cute, sure. But you’re Sana.
lines.zh: : 胡说。她可爱是可爱。可你是 Sana 啊。

lines.en: : If it were up to me, I’d grant you victory right now.
lines.zh: : 要是能由我说了算，我现在就把胜利判给你。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews23
: Well...thank you, but...that doesn’t really stop me from being nervous...
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢你，不过……这也确实没法让我不紧张……

lines.en: : Just go get some rest and we’ll talk strategy when I’m done with my interviews, okay?
lines.zh: : 先去休息吧，等我采访完了我们再聊战术，好吗？

lines.en: : Y...Yeah...Okay...
lines.zh: : 好……好的……行吧……

lines.en: scene dorminterviews24
: Ayane Amamiya, still with Action News Now, but now joined by Rin Rokuhara and Futaba Fukuyama!
lines.zh: : 还是我 Ayane Amamiya，仍在即时新闻台，现在和我一起的是 Rin Rokuhara 和 Futaba Fukuyama！

lines.en: : First off, Rin, do you really think you can take down Otoha?
lines.zh: : 首先，Rin，你真的觉得你能击败 Otoha 吗？

lines.en: : God I want nothing more than to take her down and just run my hands all over her-
lines.zh: : 天啊，我只想把她放倒，然后双手在她身上到处乱摸——

lines.en: : She means beat her, Rin.
lines.zh: : 她的意思是打败她，Rin。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...I don’t know. Maybe?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……我不知道。也许吧？

lines.en: : It’s no secret that you and Sensei are close...and many people seem to believe that he’s already in your friend zone. Are you willing to confirm for us, right here and now, that you have already won this competition?
lines.zh: : 你和 Sensei 关系亲密已经不是什么秘密了……而且很多人似乎认为他早就被你打进朋友区了。你愿意就在此时此地确认一下，你已经赢下这场比赛了吗？

lines.en: : No comment!
lines.zh: : 无可奉告！

lines.en: : I guess we’ll just have to wait and see then, won’t we?
lines.zh: : 那看来我们只能拭目以待了，对吧？

lines.en: : No comment!
lines.zh: : 无可奉告！

lines.en: : Forgive her. She’s probably just trying not to say anything weird about Otoha again...
lines.zh: : 请原谅她。她大概只是不想又对 Otoha 说出什么奇怪的话来……

lines.en: : She can get tunnel vision and is probably...thinking things right now.
lines.zh: : 她一钻牛角尖就容易……现在脑子里大概正在想些有的没的。

lines.en: : No comment!
lines.zh: : 无可奉告！

lines.en: : Then, Futaba...your contest with Molly is one of few that the second floor girls seem to have the upper hand in at first glance.
lines.zh: : 那么，Futaba……你和 Molly 的比赛，是乍看之下二楼女生占上风的少数几场之一。

lines.en: : How do you think you’ll fare using a character created by someone else to take down your own dungeon master?
lines.zh: : 用别人创造的角色去击败你自己的地下城主，你觉得胜算如何？

lines.en: : And, if victorious, how will that affect Molly’s attitude toward you in our campaign?
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你赢了，这会如何影响 Molly 在我们的战役里对你的态度？

lines.en: : I’m sure that whatever happens will be fun for both of us...
lines.zh: : 我相信不管结果如何，对我们俩来说都会很有趣……

lines.en: : If I get too focused on winning, losing will hurt ten times more if it actually happens.
lines.zh: : 要是我太执着于赢，那真输了的话，痛苦会翻上十倍。

lines.en: : So...right now, I’m just trying to think up different strategies and...umm...learn how Sana’s character works since I’ve never played as him before...
lines.zh: : 所以……现在我正努力想些不同的策略，还有……呃……熟悉一下 Sana 那个角色怎么用，因为我以前从没扮演过他……

lines.en: : Okay, I’m ready for my interview now! Hit me!
lines.zh: : 好了，我现在准备好接受采访了！来吧！

lines.en: : Thank you Futaba and sorry Rin! Because we’re out of time for you and have yet another competitor coming to the stage as we speak!
lines.zh: : 谢谢 Futaba，也抱歉了 Rin！因为你的时间已经用完了，而在我们说话的这会儿，又有一位选手来到了台上！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews25
: Chika Chosokabe! Hello!
lines.zh: : Chika Chosokabe！你好呀！

lines.en: : Heya!
: So, Chika, a lot of people are quite jealous that you get to go on a date with Sensei as your competition.
lines.zh: : 那么，Chika，很多人都很嫉妒你能以和 Sensei 约会作为比赛项目。

lines.en: : And by “a lot of people” I am specifically referring to myself. I think that it is unfair and I am very upset that it was approved.
lines.zh: : 而我说的“很多人”，具体指的就是我自己。我觉得这太不公平了，它竟然被批准通过，我非常不爽。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews26
: Oh, come on. It’ll be totally fine.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。肯定没问题的。

lines.en: : It’s not like we’re going to be alone or anything. I openly invited anyone who wants to supervise us to come and watch.
lines.zh: : 我们又不会独处什么的。我公开邀请了任何想监督我们的人来围观。

lines.en: : All I’m really trying to do is gain some points for the first floor so we can {i}all{/i} spend some extra quality time with our teacher during the beach trip.
lines.zh: : 我真正想做的只是为一楼挣点分数，这样我们在海边旅行时{i}都{/i}能和老师多度过一些宝贵的时光。

lines.en: : And that includes you, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，这也包括你。

lines.en: : Yes, I understand that. But you also challenged an incredibly rich girl to a battle to see who can throw a better date...and Sensei is very easily bought by material goods.
lines.zh: : 是，我明白。但你还向一个超级有钱的女生发起挑战，要比谁能安排出更好的约会……而 Sensei 很容易被物质收买。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews27
: I don’t think that’s true at all.
lines.zh: : 我完全不这么认为。

lines.en: : Sensei is extremely generous and far from materialistic. And I’m ready to prove that the amount of money someone has does not mean they’d make a better romantic partner.
lines.zh: : Sensei 非常慷慨，而且绝不物质。我也准备好证明，一个人有多少钱，并不代表她就会是个更好的恋人。

lines.en: : That’s cute and all, but I am still extremely jealous that you get to have a love contest with him as the center point.
lines.zh: : 说得好听，但我还是非常嫉妒你能以他为中心来一场恋爱比赛。

lines.en: : I will not forget this, Chika.
lines.zh: : 这事我记下了，Chika。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews25
: Sorry that I had the idea before you did!
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，谁让这主意是我想到你前面去了！

lines.en: : Feel free to come watch if you want!
lines.zh: : 想看的话尽管来看！

lines.en: scene dorminterviews28
: Ahh, and last but not least, we have my two best friends in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 啊，最后但同样重要的是，我们有请我在这个世界上最要好的两位朋友。

lines.en: : Hi, Ayane. You’re really good at this journalist stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Ayane。你这记者当得还真有模有样。

lines.en: : I particularly liked the part just now where you talked about how unfair it is that Chika gets to go on a date with Sensei and that I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我特别喜欢刚才那一段，你说 Chika 能和 Sensei 约会而我不行，这有多不公平。

lines.en: : {i}We{/i}. Not just you.
lines.zh: : 是{i}我们{/i}。不只是你。

lines.en: : Sure, whatever.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便啦。

lines.en: : No one is even recording this. What’s the point of conducting interviews if-
lines.zh: : 根本没人在录这个。采访的意义又何在，如果——

lines.en: : Maya Makinami, I have just received word that the test of courage between you and Tsuneyo will be taking place at my house.
lines.zh: : Maya Makinami，我刚收到消息，你和 Tsuneyo 的胆量测试将在我家举行。

lines.en: : Will competing in a place you’ve been to multiple times now help to quell any uneasiness that would normally come with a test of courage?
lines.zh: : 在一个你已经去过好几次的地方比赛，能缓解胆量测试通常会带来的不安吗？

lines.en: : ...Where did you receive word from? We’ve been watching you this whole time.
lines.zh: : ……你是从哪儿收到消息的？我们可是一直在看着你。

lines.en: : Just answer the question, Maya.
lines.zh: : 回答问题就好，Maya。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess? I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……大概吧？我不知道。

lines.en: : I haven’t really thought about it.
lines.zh: : 我还真没怎么想过。

lines.en: : Who’s even setting up the test of courage? How long will it be?
lines.zh: : 到底是谁在布置这场胆量测试？会有多长时间？

lines.en: : I have a bunch of questions.
lines.zh: : 我有一堆问题。

lines.en: : Those questions would just go on to ruin the test! And I refuse to cheat, so you’ll just have to wait and see what’s in store.
lines.zh: : 这些问题只会毁了测试！而且我拒绝作弊，所以你就等着看有什么在等着你吧。

lines.en: : As for you, Ami, a lot of people are saying you already have this contest in the bag. Do you have any response to that?
lines.zh: : 至于你，Ami，很多人都说你已经赢定了。对此你有什么回应吗？

lines.en: : My response is that they are correct.
lines.zh: : 我的回应是，他们说得对。

lines.en: : If it involves Sensei, I will win.
lines.zh: : 只要牵扯到 Sensei，赢的人一定是我。

lines.en: : That is my role in not only his life, but my own.
lines.zh: : 这不仅是我自己的人生定位，也是我在他人生中的定位。

lines.en: : And if Noriko thinks she can swoop in and take that away from me, she can drink battery acid.
lines.zh: : 要是 Noriko 以为她能横插一脚把这一切从我手里抢走，那她可以去喝电池水。

lines.en: : Fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: scene dorminterviews29
: Great! Well, that concludes our pre-war interviews! But join us tomorrow morning for more coverage as we kick things off with “Imouto Mode! Little Sister Contest!” right here on Action News Now!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那么，我们的赛前采访到此结束！不过明天早上请继续锁定即时新闻台，我们将以“妹妹模式！小妹妹比赛！”拉开战幕！

lines.en: : I’m Ayane Amamiya, and thanks for joining!
lines.zh: : 我是 Ayane Amamiya，感谢收看！

lines.en: : What are we looking at? There’s no camera there.
lines.zh: : 我们在看什么啊？那儿根本没有摄像机。

lines.en: : Just roll with it, Ami. Just roll with it.
lines.zh: : 顺着演就是了，Ami。顺着演就是了。

lines.en: scene black
scene bedroom_night
: Hah...
I make my way into the bedroom after an extremely confusing day.
lines.zh: 在度过了极其混乱的一天后，我走进卧室。

lines.en: No one bothered texting me back on my way home, so I don’t even know when the competition thing is going to start.
lines.zh: 回家路上没人回我消息，所以我连比赛什么时候开始都不知道。

lines.en: But to begin with Ami and Noriko facing off...
lines.zh: 不过一上来就是 Ami 和 Noriko 正面对决……

lines.en: It seems like that could get a little ugly.
lines.zh: 看样子可能会有点难看。

lines.en: I don’t really think either of them considers the other a {i}rival{/i} per se, but there’s definitely a good amount of history between myself and each of them.
lines.zh: 我觉得她们俩其实都没真的把对方当成{i}对手{/i}，但我和她们各自之间确实都有不少过往。

lines.en: I just hope that whatever happens doesn’t end up with one of them having their head ripped off and placed on a pike.
lines.zh: 我只希望不管发生什么，最后别演变成其中一个被拧下脑袋插在长矛上。

lines.en: Welp, time to go to sleep.
lines.zh: 好吧，该睡了。

lines.en: scene black
I climb into bed and close my eyes, both nervous and excited for whatever daylight will bring.
lines.zh: 我爬上床闭上眼睛，对天亮后将要发生的一切既紧张又兴奋。

lines.en: {i}Let the games begin!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}让比赛开始吧！{/i}

lines.en: $ dormwar2 = True
$ totaldays += 1
$ day += 1
[totaldays] Days have passed...
lines.zh: [totaldays] 天过去了……
